moves.name: Compel
moves.triggerShort: When you attempt to persuade someone to do something.
moves.trigger:
When you **attempt to persuade someone to do something**, envision your approach and roll. If you…
- Charm, pacify, barter, or convince: Roll **+heart** (add +1 if you share a bond).
- Threaten or incite: Roll **+iron**.
- Lie or swindle: Roll **+shadow**.
moves.triggerPreamble: When you **attempt to persuade someone to do something**, envision your approach and roll. If you…

stats.desc: Charm, pacify, barter, or convince (add +1 if you share a bond)

moves.strong: They'll do what you want or share what they know. [Take +1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1). If you use this exchange to [Gather Information](move:gather-information), make that move now and add +1.
moves.weak: [They'll do what you want or share what they know. [Take +1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1). Envision what they want ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure).
moves.miss: They refuse or make a demand which costs you greatly. [Pay the Price](move:pay-the-price).
moves.notes: The bond bonus (+1) only applies when you charm, pacify, barter, or convince using +heart. Use the modifier control to add it when applicable.

moves.name: Sojourn
moves.triggerShort: When you spend time in a community seeking assistance.
moves.trigger: When you **spend time in a community seeking assistance**, roll **+heart**. If you share a bond, add +1.

stats.desc: Spending time in a community (add +1 if you share a bond)

moves.strong:
You and your allies may each choose **two**:
**Clear a Condition**
- Mend: Clear a [wounded](debility:wounded?value=0) debility and take [+1 health](resource:health?value=+1).
- Hearten: Clear a [shaken](debility:shaken?value=0) debility and take [+1 spirit](resource:spirit?value=+1).
- Equip: Clear an [unprepared](debility:unprepared?value=0) debility and take [+1 supply](resource:supply?value=+1).**Recover**
- Recuperate: Take [+2 health](resource:health?value=+2) for yourself and any companions.
- Consort: Take [+2 spirit](resource:spirit?value=+2).
- Provision: Take [+2 supply](resource:supply?value=+2).
- Plan: Take [+2 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+2).**Provide Aid**
- Take a quest: Envision what this community needs ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure). If you choose to help, [Swear an Iron Vow](move:swear-an-iron-vow) and add +1.

moves.name: Draw the Circle
moves.triggerShort: When you challenge someone to a formal duel, or accept a challenge.
moves.trigger: When you **challenge someone to a formal duel, or accept a challenge**, roll **+heart**. If you share a bond with this community, add +1.

stats.desc: Challenging or accepting a formal duel (add +1 if bonded community)

moves.strong:
Take [+1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1). You may also choose up to three boasts and take +1 momentum for each.
- Grant first strike: [Your foe has initiative](initiative:foe).
- Bare yourself: Take no benefit of armor or shield; your foe's harm is +1.
- Hold no iron: Take no benefit of weapons; your harm is 1.
- Bloody yourself: [Endure Harm](move:endure-harm?harm=1) (1 harm).
- To the death: One way or another, this fight must end with death.
moves.weak:

- Grant first strike: [Your foe has initiative](initiative:foe).
- Bare yourself: Take no benefit of armor or shield; your foe's harm is +1.
- Hold no iron: Take no benefit of weapons; your harm is 1.
- Bloody yourself: [Endure Harm](move:endure-harm?harm=1) (1 harm).
- To the death: One way or another, this fight must end with death.]{.log-only}
moves.miss: You begin the duel at a disadvantage. [Your foe has initiative](initiative:foe). [Pay the Price](move:pay-the-price).
moves.notes: Then, make moves to resolve the fight. If you are the victor, you may make a lawful demand, and your opponent must comply or forfeit their honor and standing. If you refuse the challenge, surrender, or are defeated, they make a demand of you.

moves.name: Forge a Bond
moves.triggerShort: When you spend significant time with a person or community.
moves.trigger: When you **spend significant time with a person or community, stand together to face hardships, or make sacrifices for their cause**, you can attempt to create a bond. When you do, roll **+heart**. If you make this move after you successfully [Fulfill Your Vow](move:fulfill-your-vow) to their benefit, you may reroll any dice.

stats.desc: Forging a bond with a person or community

moves.strong:
Make note of the bond, [mark a tick](resource:bonds?value=+1) on your bond progress track, and choose one:
- Take [+1 spirit](resource:spirit?value=+1).
- Take [+2 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+2).
moves.weak: They ask something more of you first. Envision what it is ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure), do it (or [Swear an Iron Vow](move:swear-an-iron-vow)), and [mark the bond](resource:bonds?value=+1). If you decline or fail, [Pay the Price](move:pay-the-price).
moves.notes: If you make this move after you [Fulfill Your Vow](move:fulfill-your-vow) to the benefit of the person or community, you may reroll any dice. Use the reroll button when applicable.

moves.name: Test Your Bond
moves.triggerShort: When your bond is tested through conflict, betrayal, or circumstance.
moves.trigger: When **your bond is tested through conflict, betrayal, or circumstance**, roll **+heart**.

stats.desc: Testing a bond through conflict, betrayal, or circumstance

moves.strong:
This test has strengthened your bond. Choose one:
- Take [+1 spirit](resource:spirit?value=+1).
- Take [+2 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+2).
moves.weak: Your bond is fragile and you must prove your loyalty. Envision what they ask of you ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure), and do it (or [Swear an Iron Vow](move:swear-an-iron-vow)). If you decline or fail, clear the bond and [Pay the Price](move:pay-the-price).
moves.miss: Or if you have no interest in maintaining this relationship, clear the bond and [Pay the Price](move:pay-the-price).
moves.notes: Triggered by the fiction, not player choice. If something happens that would logically strain a meaningful relationship, this move is prompted. The miss text also applies if you simply have no interest in maintaining the relationship.

moves.name: Aid Your Ally
moves.triggerShort: When you Secure an Advantage in direct support of an ally.
moves.trigger: When you [Secure an Advantage](move:secure-an-advantage) **in direct support of an ally**, and score a hit, they (instead of you) can take the benefits of the move. If you are in combat and score a strong hit, you and your ally have initiative.
moves.notes: This is not a separate roll — you make a Secure an Advantage roll and can give the benefits to your ally instead. In combat, a strong hit grants initiative to both of you.

moves.name: Write Your Epilogue
moves.triggerShort: When you retire from your life as Ironsworn.
moves.trigger: When you **retire from your life as Ironsworn**, envision two things: What you hope for, and what you fear. Then, roll the challenge dice and compare to your **bonds**. You may not burn momentum on this roll, and you are not affected by negative momentum.

stats.desc: Roll against your bond progress track

moves.strong: Things come to pass as you hoped.
moves.weak: Your life takes an unexpected turn, but not necessarily for the worse. You find yourself spending your days with someone or in a place you did not foresee. Envision it ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure).
moves.notes: A progress move — roll challenge dice against your bond progress track. No action die. You may not burn momentum on this roll, and you are not affected by negative momentum.
